emission_factor_source_note: Virgin cardboard factor reported by Carbonfact from ADEME/DEFRA comparison; use as a benchmark, not an India-specific supplier factor.
cost_source_note: No defensible public India-wide material-only price found for a defined virgin corrugated-board grade; use supplier quote.
density_source_note: Corrugated board density depends on liner/medium GSM, flute profile and moisture; do not use a single universal density.
recycled_content_source_note: Virgin category is defined here as 0% recycled fibre.
recyclability_region: Depends on local system and coatings
recyclability_source_note: Corrugated cardboard is widely recyclable, but actual acceptance depends on contamination/coatings/local collection.
compostability_source_note: Fibre board can biodegrade/compost, but coatings, adhesives and contamination can change eligibility.
water_resistance_source_note: Prototype engineering score; uncoated corrugated loses performance with moisture. Must be replaced by supplier/test data for production.
strength_rating_source_note: Prototype normalized score, not an ASTM/ECT rating. Actual strength depends on flute, GSM and board grade.
print_compatibility_source_note: Typical corrugated packaging supports flexographic/digital/offset-laminated print; exact quality is grade/process dependent.
supplier_availability_source_note: Corrugated boxes are widely supplied in India; availability is market-level, not a guarantee for a specific grade/MOQ.

emission_factor_source_note: Recycled cardboard factor reported by Carbonfact from DEFRA; methodology and geography differ from India.
cost_source_note: Indicative recycled kraft paper input prices in 2026; this is not finished corrugated-board price.
density_source_note: Depends on board construction; no universal density.
recycled_content_source_note: Industry benchmark for standard recycled-content corrugated; actual supplier declaration should override.
recyclability_region: Depends on local system and coatings
recyclability_source_note: Corrugated cardboard is widely recyclable; contamination/coatings can affect acceptance.
compostability_source_note: Fibre packaging can be compostable in suitable systems, but finished-pack specifications matter.
water_resistance_source_note: Prototype normalized score; moisture performance is construction/coating dependent.
strength_rating_source_note: Prototype normalized score; actual ECT/BCT depends on grade and flute.
print_compatibility_source_note: Printability varies with liner surface and converting process.
supplier_availability_source_note: Recycled kraft/corrugated supply is common; specific grade and MOQ must be quoted.

emission_factor_source_note: Verified CarbonCloud footprint for uncoated kraft paper and paperboard at factory stage.
cost_source_note: 2026 indicative ranges spanning recycled and virgin kraft grades; not a single grade price.
density_source_note: Paper density depends on basis weight, caliper and grade; use supplier GSM/caliper to derive apparent density.
recycled_content_source_note: Kraft paper may be virgin or recycled; supplier declaration required.
recyclability_source_note: Uncoated paper is generally recyclable; laminations/coatings can change the result.
compostability_source_note: Uncoated fibre is generally biodegradable; additives/coatings may alter eligibility.
water_resistance_source_note: Uncoated kraft has limited moisture resistance; coatings can improve it.
strength_rating_source_note: Prototype normalized score; actual strength depends on BF/ECT/GSM and fibre.
print_compatibility_source_note: Printability depends on surface treatment and printing process.
supplier_availability_source_note: Multiple grades are commercially available; prices vary by GSM, recycled content and order volume.

emission_factor_source_note: Verified CarbonCloud footprint for molded pulp box/carton at factory stage.
cost_source_note: No robust public material-only India price found; molded pulp is strongly tooling/design dependent. Use supplier quote.
density_source_note: Depends strongly on wet/dry molding process, wall thickness and fibre furnish.
recycled_content_source_note: Can range from recycled paper fibre to virgin/agricultural fibres; supplier declaration required.
recyclability_value: Usually yes if fibre-based and clean
recyclability_source_note: Fibre packaging can be recyclable, but barriers/coatings and local acceptance matter.
compostability_source_note: Traditional moulded pulp is fibre based, but coatings/barriers can alter end-of-life.
water_resistance_source_note: Molded pulp can lose strength in humid conditions; barriers/coatings can improve this.
strength_rating_source_note: Prototype normalized score; actual compression/drop performance is design-specific.
print_compatibility_source_note: Surface finish varies substantially by process; printed appearance is generally less precise than coated paper/plastic film.
supplier_availability_source_note: Commercially available, but custom molded pulp normally requires tooling and supplier qualification.

emission_factor_source_note: No sufficiently comparable public factor found in this research pass. Do not silently substitute ordinary paper; honeycomb conversion adds process and geometry effects.
cost_source_note: Supplier/converter quote required; pricing is product-format and roll-width dependent.
density_source_note: Apparent density is geometry-dependent and should be derived from finished product mass/volume.
recyclability_source_note: Paper-based construction can be recyclable; adhesives/coatings may change acceptance.
compostability_source_note: Fibre-based construction is generally biodegradable; finished construction matters.
water_resistance_source_note: Prototype default; coating and basis weight can change moisture performance.
strength_rating_source_note: Prototype normalized score reflecting cellular structure; validate with compression/drop tests.
print_compatibility_source_note: Printability is generally inherited from the paper face; finished geometry limits some printing.
supplier_availability_source_note: Available through packaging converters, but not as ubiquitous as corrugated board.

emission_factor_source_note: Depends on paper, adhesive chemistry and coating; use supplier EPD/PCF rather than a generic tape factor.
cost_source_note: Tape is normally priced by roll/length rather than kg; use supplier quote and normalize to ₹/m.
density_source_note: Not useful as a single material property for a multilayer tape.
recycled_content_source_note: Depends on paper backing and adhesive.
recyclability_source_note: Tape can affect fibre recovery; use converter/recycler guidance for the exact tape construction.
compostability_source_note: Paper backing does not guarantee the adhesive is compostable.
water_resistance_source_note: Prototype score; adhesive and coating determine actual resistance.
strength_rating_source_note: Prototype normalized score; actual tensile/adhesion performance is product-specific.
print_compatibility_source_note: Paper surfaces can generally accept printing; exact ink/coating compatibility is supplier-specific.
supplier_availability_source_note: Paper tapes are commercially common; exact recyclable/compostable construction must be verified.

emission_factor_source_note: NatureWorks publishes an Eco-Profile methodology but this research pass did not retrieve a current numeric factor suitable for direct use. Leave null rather than inventing one.
cost_source_note: Grade and imported/local supply strongly affect price; supplier quote required.
density_source_note: Technical property for a specific PLA film grade; do not generalize to every PLA formulation.
recycled_content_source_note: Set to 0 for the virgin PLA baseline; recycled PLA is a different material record.
recyclability_source_note: PLA recycling infrastructure is not equivalent to PET/PE recycling and is highly location dependent.
compostability_value: Industrial composting only for certified grades
compostability_source_note: Do not label PLA simply 'compostable' without certification and a suitable industrial composting system.
water_resistance_source_note: Prototype score; grade and film thickness determine barrier performance.
strength_rating_source_note: Prototype normalized score; use grade-specific tensile/impact data for engineering.
print_compatibility_source_note: Specific PLA film grades are designed for film conversion and printing/packaging applications; validate ink adhesion.
supplier_availability_source_note: Commercial PLA exists, but availability depends on grade and converter capability.

emission_factor_source_note: Verified CarbonCloud footprint for recycled PET plastic film roll stock; use as a packaging-film benchmark, not generic rPET resin.
cost_source_note: Grade, PCR percentage and food-contact status materially affect price; supplier quote required.
density_source_note: MatWeb technical data for a PET grade; rPET density can be similar but exact grade should be verified.
recycled_content_source_note: This record represents recycled PET as the polymer feedstock; actual finished packaging may contain virgin content/additives.
recyclability_source_note: PET is widely recyclable, but actual packaging recyclability depends on format, labels, colours and local infrastructure.
water_resistance_source_note: Prototype score; PET has low moisture absorption and is used as a barrier film.
strength_rating_source_note: Prototype normalized score based on PET mechanical performance; exact film grade required for design.
print_compatibility_source_note: PET packaging films are widely printed after surface treatment; exact ink/process is grade dependent.
supplier_availability_source_note: rPET packaging grades exist, but food-contact and film grades require specific supplier qualification.

emission_factor_source_note: BAFA factor retrieved through Climatiq for LDPE; material-level benchmark, not India-specific film conversion.
cost_source_note: Mailer cost depends strongly on thickness, size, printing and order volume; use supplier quote per piece and derive material cost.
density_source_note: ASTM D1505 density for a specific LDPE resin grade.
recycled_content_source_note: Baseline record assumes virgin LDPE; PCR/ recycled LDPE should be separate records.
recyclability_value: Yes in principle; collection limited for films
recyclability_source_note: LDPE is recyclable as a polymer, but flexible film collection is less universal than rigid PET.
water_resistance_source_note: Prototype score; LDPE is commonly used where moisture resistance is required.
strength_rating_source_note: Prototype normalized score; puncture/tear strength depends on film gauge and grade.
print_compatibility_source_note: LDPE films can be printed after appropriate surface treatment; exact process is converter dependent.
supplier_availability_source_note: PE film/mailer supply is widespread; exact PCR content and thickness must be verified.

emission_factor_source_note: Myco reports this value from an emissions audit for its own mycelium packaging. This must NOT be treated as a generic mycelium factor.
density_source_note: Depends on substrate, growth and final density; use supplier datasheet.
recycled_content_source_note: Feedstock is typically agricultural/organic residue rather than recycled polymer; do not map this to recycled-content percentage without a supplier definition.
recyclability_source_note: Mycelium products are generally designed for biological end-of-life rather than conventional plastic recycling.
compostability_source_note: Must be verified for the actual substrate, binder/additives and certification.
water_resistance_source_note: Prototype score; water resistance varies with coating and composite formulation.
strength_rating_source_note: Prototype normalized score; actual compression/impact performance is formulation-specific.
print_compatibility_source_note: Surface texture generally limits conventional high-resolution print; labels/overwrap may be more suitable.
supplier_availability_source_note: Emerging category with fewer suppliers than paper/plastic packaging.

emission_factor_source_note: Glassine is highly calendered paper; a generic paper factor may misrepresent the additional processing. Use supplier PCF/EPD.
cost_source_note: Supplier quote required; glassine is a specialty paper.
recyclability_source_note: Paper recyclability depends on coatings, inks and local acceptance.
compostability_source_note: Paper fibre is biodegradable; coatings/additives can alter end-of-life.
water_resistance_source_note: Glassine is grease/moisture resistant relative to ordinary paper, but exact barrier depends on grade.
strength_rating_source_note: Prototype score; exact tensile/tear strength depends on GSM and grade.
print_compatibility_source_note: Printable grades exist; ink adhesion and surface treatment are supplier/process dependent.
supplier_availability_source_note: Specialty paper rather than commodity packaging material; supplier qualification recommended.

emission_factor_source_note: Verified CarbonCloud footprint for PET/Alu/PE sachet film. This is a finished laminate benchmark, not aluminum foil alone.
cost_source_note: Laminate price depends on layer structure, thickness, print and order volume; quote required.
density_source_note: Composite density must be calculated from layer thickness and density; do not use pure aluminum density for the laminate.
recycled_content_source_note: Depends on PET/Al/PE layers; supplier declaration required.
recyclability_source_note: Multi-material laminates are more difficult to mechanically recycle than mono-material packaging.
water_resistance_source_note: High barrier laminate; exact performance depends on sealant/layer construction.
strength_rating_source_note: Prototype normalized score; laminate mechanical performance depends on layer thickness and seal construction.
print_compatibility_source_note: Flexible laminates are widely used for printed packaging; exact process depends on structure.
supplier_availability_region: Flexible laminate converting is widely established; exact sustainable/recyclable structures vary.

emission_factor_source_note: Ink footprint varies by binder, pigments, solids and drying energy; use supplier PCF/EPD.
cost_source_note: Ink price depends on chemistry, colour, pigment loading and print process.
recycled_content_source_note: Not generally a primary packaging-material metric; depends on formulation.
recyclability_value: Generally compatible with paper recycling when designed appropriately
recyclability_source_note: Ink chemistry and deinking behaviour matter; verify with printer/recycler.
compostability_source_note: Water-based does not automatically mean compostable.
water_resistance_source_note: Prototype score; cured formulation and substrate determine resistance.
strength_rating_source_note: Not a structural material; set low because it should not contribute materially to packaging strength.
print_compatibility_source_note: Water-based inks are widely used in flexographic printing of paper and corrugated packaging.
supplier_availability_source_note: Water-based inks are commercially established in paper/corrugated printing.

emission_factor_source_note: Soy-based ink is a formulation category; no single defensible generic footprint found. Use supplier PCF/EPD.
cost_source_note: Formulation and pigment dependent; supplier quote required.
recycled_content_source_note: Not generally a primary packaging-material metric.
recyclability_value: Generally compatible with paper recycling when designed appropriately
recyclability_source_note: Deinking and formulation matter; do not assume from the word 'soy'.
compostability_source_note: Bio-based binder does not automatically make the full ink compostable.
water_resistance_source_note: Prototype score; cured formulation determines actual resistance.
strength_rating_source_note: Not structural; score is not an engineering strength metric.
print_compatibility_source_note: Soy-based inks are used in commercial printing; exact substrate/process compatibility is supplier specific.
supplier_availability_source_note: Available from specialty ink suppliers/printers; not as universal as conventional inks.
